title: SteelSeries Arctis Nova 5 Wireless Gaming Headset $149.39 (RRP $299) Delivered @ Amazon JP via AU
body:
Deal: SteelSeries Arctis Nova 5 Wireless Gaming Headset $149.39 (RRP $299) Delivered @ Amazon JP via AU

[GreenLego] Great headset, but for my own personal use, I listen to podcasts while playing games, so I need to be able to mix bluetooth and game audio at the same time. This headset can't do it, so not for me.
[noshopping] I think the SteelSeries Arctis Nova 7 /Nova Pro Wireless series can do that.
[chid] I must say I like this headset. Bluetooth + 2.4 perfect for most occasions where you need one at a time.
[siriusttt] have it for 8 months , very good buy. Had a bose one as well, i keep it packed.
[Nvu] I know these nothing headphones are much more expensive but its close to 50% off like this deal
[Kambo_Rambo] The nothing headphones isnt designed as a pc headset. It will have issues when trying to use both mic and headphones via bluetooth.
[cheekymonkey97] I like this headset, they're great but beware the ear cups are a bit small. I miss having the earcup size of the hyperx 2 :(
[grb] Nice headset. The battery life is awesome. It took me a bit to get used to the pairing and switching modes but it works fine. Feels a bit plastic-y after coming from more premium stuff but they definitely don't feel budget, and I can wear them fine for hours. They're also pretty durable, having survived plenty of drops to my wood floor. Sound is decent but I never overly cared about mic quality in my daily use, however ymmv.
